# GAMEDAY TV | Del 6: Indiespelutvecklare - från spel till kapital. Tobbe med TA

**Feed**: trading-direkt  
**Published**: 2026-10-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This episode of GAMEDAY TV has two parts. First, an interview with Ellinor Bergman of the indie studio Speldosa Interactive covers bootstrapping a studio, the hard funding climate since Embracer's failed 2023 deal, the narrow exit routes (mainly selling to Tencent), and Steam's importance for discoverability. Second, Tobbe Rosén runs a technical analysis (Ichimoku, trend-phase indicator, volatility) of a gaming index. He is positive on Embracer, Sony, Asmodee and Stillfront and negative on NetEase, Enad Global 7 and Take-Two. The gaming index lags OMXS30 so far this year but is ahead of it over the last 6 months.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EMBRAC-B — Embracer Group | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 80%

Low-volatility uptrend respecting the standard line, positive volume balance, trend phase high; report on 11 Nov.

#### Reasoning

The analyst (Tobbe Rosén, technical segment) is clearly positive. Pullbacks keep bouncing off the standard line, volatility is low and volume balance is positive, and Ichimoku points to further gains. He warns that a trend phase near +7 turning down, plus negative divergence on stochastic MACD, could bring a short pullback before the next breakout higher.

#### Sell Triggers

- trend-phase indicator turns down from +7 or above
- price breaks below the standard line

> *"Så jag är tydligt positiv till Embracer, även om den då är lite kortsiktigt överköpt med negativ divergens."*

---

### 🟢 SONY — Sony Group | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 80%

Positive trend phase and volume balance; slightly overbought; pullbacks seen as buying opportunities.

#### Reasoning

The analyst is very positive. Because volatility is above average, he would buy positive candlestick continuation formations once the cycle indicator drops below 40 (ideally below 20, with a positive mini-divergence). Support sits at Cloud Span B and the gap supports below.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below Cloud Span B and the gap supports

> *"Så jag är mycket positiv till Sonny och som jag ser det här så är ju då rekyler definitivt köpvärda."*

---

### 🟢 ASMDEE-B — Asmodee | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

New all-time high; healthy rising trend; positive volume balance; strong breakouts are buyable at low volatility; report on 13 Nov.

#### Reasoning

Trend phase sits between +2 and +7, which favours trend-following. Low volatility makes strong breakouts on rising volume buyable. Pullbacks respect the standard line. Ichimoku warns of a flat rate of advance and possible consolidation periods.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak close below the standard line, risking a drop into the cloud

> *"Det var då Asmody som jag är positiv till."*

---

### 🟢 SF — Stillfront Group | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Price respected Cloud Span B after a negatively received report; oversold; high volatility contracting; positive candlestick formation.

#### Reasoning

The analyst sees it as very interesting. High volatility contracting after a fall often brings a trend shift or a rebound, and yesterday's positive candlestick formation could trigger further gains. He cautions that investors should understand why the market reacted negatively to the report.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below Cloud Span B
- fundamental issues from the report worsen

> *"Men den ser jätteintressant ut tycker jag, Stillfront."*

---

### 🟠 RBLX — Roblox | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up 37% since late September and back above MA200; expects a pullback that would be buyable if it holds the standard line around 48-50.

#### Reasoning

Ichimoku components all point higher and the trend phase is positive. However, stochastic MACD is about to give a negative cross and MA200 is still trending down, so the analyst is only neutral to weakly positive. He wants to buy a pullback that holds support.

#### Sell Triggers

- pullback breaks the standard line around 48-50

> *"så är det ganska goda förutsättningar för att en sådan rekyl kommer vara köpvärd"*

---

### 🟢 U — Unity Software | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Best 6-month performer; contraction above Cloud Span B; main scenario is an upside breakout.

#### Reasoning

Mixed picture: price is above Cloud Span B, but the lagging line is below price and key averages, and the trend phase warns of sharp swings. The analyst is weakly positive while price stays above Cloud Span B.

#### Sell Triggers

- price breaks below Cloud Span B, risking a fall toward MA200

> *"Jag är dock svagt positiv."*

---

### 🟠 COFFEE-B — Coffee Stain Group | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Low-volatility triangle-like range; upside breakout most likely; report on 5 Nov.

#### Reasoning

Trend phase is still positive but nearing the neutral zone, and volume balance is turning neutral. A long low-volatility period usually ends in a powerful move. The analyst is neutral but says it is worth watching for an upside breakout.

#### Sell Triggers

- breakdown out of the range

> *"Så väl värd att hålla koll på tycker jag."*

---

### 🟠 MTG-B — Modern Times Group | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Positive stochastic cross after a large decline; high volatility contracting, favouring an upside move; report due.

#### Reasoning

High volatility contracting after a steep fall often precedes a reversal or rebound, here likely upward. Short term it is slightly negative, and volume balance is negative. The analyst calls it an interesting piece of the puzzle to watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- further decline with negative volume balance

> *"Faktiskt en intressant och positiv pusselbit tycker jag i MTG. Så intressant och hålla koll på."*

---

### ⛔ NTES — NetEase | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 75%

Negative trend phase; rebounds expected to be short pauses in a continuing decline.

#### Reasoning

The trend-phase indicator is in the zone where rebounds are pauses in a downtrend. Volatility just above average raises the risk of a further fall. The analyst is fairly clearly negative.

> *"Så jag är ganska tydligt negativ till NetEase."*

---

### ⛔ EG7 — Enad Global 7 | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Downtrend after the Q2 top broke the standard line and Cloud Span B; negative trend phase and volume balance; report on 10 Nov.

#### Reasoning

The analyst is negative: direction is down, and the trend phase warns of further losses. A possible double-bottom-like pattern near 13.60 could start a rally toward Cloud Span B, but he wants price to establish itself above Cloud Span B first.

#### Sell Triggers

- thesis invalidated if the double bottom triggers and price holds above Cloud Span B

> *"Jag är negativ till enad global 7."*

---

### ⛔ TTWO — Take-Two Interactive | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Every change in Cloud Span B is negative; volume balance clearly negative; support at 188-190; very low volatility.

#### Reasoning

The analyst is negative. He wants a positive candlestick formation and a break above recent short-term tops without new lower lows before turning less negative. Extremely low volatility means the next move could be powerful in either direction.

#### Sell Triggers

- thesis invalidated by a positive candlestick formation and a break above recent short-term tops without new lower lows

> *"Så med det sagt så är jag negativ."*

---

### 🟠 PDX — Paradox Interactive | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Very oversold ahead of the report; neutral volume balance; key levels are 141 and 133/MA200.

#### Reasoning

The analyst is neutral to slightly negative. Reclaiming the short-term top at 141 would be constructive. A break of MA200 and 133 would likely send it lower.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below MA200 and 133

> *"jag är neutral till lite, lite svagt negativ till paradox så som det ser ut just nu"*

---

### 🟠 7974 — Nintendo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Range-bound; choppy-zone warnings from the trend phase and Cloud Span B.

#### Reasoning

The analyst is neutral to slightly negative. A break above the range top or below the range bottom could trigger a clear move, but choppy trading is more likely for now. He is unsure he charted the right Japanese instrument.

#### Sell Triggers

- breakdown below the range

> *"Så jag är neutral till, kanske lite svagt, svagt negativ till Nintendo så som det ser ut just nu."*

---

### 🟡 G5EN — G5 Entertainment | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

MA200 falling; choppy trading expected; report on 4 Nov.

#### Reasoning

The analyst is neutral. Ichimoku and the trend phase both warn of choppy, whipsaw moves, and a key level must break to resolve the uncertainty.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below key support levels

> *"Det var det som var G5 Entertainment som jag är neutral till utifrån det här."*
